correctness.rationale: For all complex quasi-projective X, Macdonald/Gusein-Zade power-structure identity yields sum chi_c(Sym^n X)t^n=(1−t)^(-c) with integer c=chi_c(X). Coefficient extraction yields stated signed/unsigned binomials and zero cases. Kummer 1852 theorem exactly identifies p-adic valuation of each binomial coefficient with base-p carries. For genus g>=2, Macdonald gives chi(Sym^n C)=(-1)^n binom(2g−2,n); classical all-interior-binomial gcd theorem gives p iff 2g−2=p^a and 1 otherwise, hence gcd2 iff g=2^r+1. Independent finite checks reproduced gcd through g=119. Correct but entirely assembled from stated known theorems.
